answer: The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in ocean, expire in tundra, and harbor lists each expiry. Someone running 53 aliases as a result needs 167 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3154 identities would post 2714 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
